findings.what: managent archive command: moves done/failed rows from tasks.json to archive.json. Eligibility: done/failed, no live dependents, holds committed (git ls-files), findings absorbed (C7 clean per claimlint).
cmdWhy searches both live store and archive store. Archived rows appear with '(archived)' marker.
Dry-run mode (--dry-run) prints what would be archived without writing. Idempotent — second run changes nothing.

gaps: cmdAudit does not search the archive store yet — archived rows with uncommitted holds won't be flagged
Absorption check parses claimlint stdout (brittle to format changes)
The 'one live dependent' is T317 needing T315 (now archived) — T317's needs edge was cleaned but the count was from before cleaning
